hypothesis: Explicit short-versus-long form contrasts and their within-race relative values can expose changes in racer condition that are difficult for tree splits over separate raw aggregates to represent.

feature_rule.candidate_interaction: first, second, and third lane contrast vectors plus lane categorical ids
feature_rule.missing_policy: retain NaN for LightGBM native missing handling
feature_rule.history_policy: all source aggregates were built from strictly prior dates; current exhibition is available before prediction

model.development: D6 inner fit/calibration, D7 test; D6 fit, D7 gamma calibration, D8 test
model.freeze_if_passed: fit D6+D7 and calibrate gamma on D8
